amount_notes: Up to $20,000 from Futurpreneur plus up to $40,000 from BDC. Combined max $60,000. THIS IS A LOAN — repayment required. Not a non-repayable grant.
eligibility_criteria: Entrepreneur must be 18 to 39 years of age
Must be Canadian citizen or permanent resident
Business must be for-profit and early stage
Must work with a Futurpreneur mentor
Business operating or launching within 12 months
exclusions: CRITICAL: Loan not a grant — repayment required
NFP and charitable organizations not eligible
notes: LOAN NOT GRANT. Will appear in FINANCING section only, never in program grant rankings. Not applicable to Emerge Academy. Relevant for Sacral Solutions if founders under 40.
